post.summary: Start a render. Send the image in the same call: a link, base64, or the file itself as multipart form data. Charged at the engine price when it starts; a failed render is refunded.

parameters.name: wait
parameters.description: Hold the answer up to this many seconds (1 to 90) while the render runs, and answer with the finished jobs in `jobs`. Still running when the time is up: a 202; read the job with GET /v2/jobs/{id}?wait=90 until it settles.

get.summary: Read a job: its status, its outputs as signed links that expire, what it was charged and refunded, and why it failed. A job and its outputs are kept 7 days.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The job id a create call answered with.

parameters.name: wait
parameters.description: Hold the answer up to this many seconds (1 to 90) until the job settles; it answers as soon as it does. Call again while status is queued or processing.

credits_charged.description: Deprecated: read `charged_usd`. The same amount in API credits ($0.0099 each).

credits_refunded.description: Deprecated: read `refunded_usd`. The same amount in API credits ($0.0099 each).

get.summary: Follow a job as Server-Sent Events, for one that outlasts ?wait: a job event with the job as it stands and each time it changes, then one last event (done with the settled job, timeout after 10 minutes, or error) and the stream closes. Every event's data is JSON; done's and job's are the job as GET /v2/jobs/{id} reads it.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The job id a create call answered with.

200.description: The stream: `event: job`, then one of `event: done`, `event: timeout` or `event: error`. A `: ping` comment keeps it alive while nothing changes.

post.summary: Stop a queued or running job. Refunded at once if it had not started; otherwise refunded if nothing is delivered.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The job id a create call answered with.

get.summary: A job's output, at the signed link GET /v2/jobs/{id} gave. No key: the signature is the credential, until it expires.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The job id a create call answered with.

parameters.name: exp
parameters.description: When the link expires (part of the link).

200.description: The file: an image, watermarked on plans that mark downloads, or a video.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Your own key, 1 to 255 visible ASCII characters. A retry with the same key and request within 24 hours returns the first answer instead of running again.

RequestId.description: This request, for support and the console log.

RateLimitLimit.description: Requests this key may make per minute.

RateLimitRemaining.description: Requests left in the current minute.

RateLimitReset.description: Seconds until the current minute resets.

IdempotentReplayed.description: Present, as `true`, when this is the stored answer to an earlier request.

Unauthenticated.description: The API key is missing, malformed, unknown or revoked.

RateLimited.description: A limit was reached: requests per minute, or a daily or concurrency limit.

InsufficientCredits.description: The balance does not cover this call.

Conflict.description: The Idempotency-Key was reused for a different request, or is still in progress.

Error.description: Any other error, in the same envelope.
